limitations: All reference policies are scripted (labelled scripted in evidence); no learned policy has been shown to succeed in these five domains.

Behavioural parameters of the new mechanisms (FR-LEARN-1..6, FR-FIRMS-JOBS, FR-FLEET-USERS, FR-PLANT-LABOR, FR-TECH-ADOPT, FR-ELSEWHERE-1) are literature-grounded or plausible functional forms, not fitted in-world (category 'plausible, unvalidated' / 'deliberate simplification' in FIDELITY_REGISTER).

Education content is limited to arithmetic/number-theory/algebra concepts with executable generators and solvers (domains.concepts); lessons are read by a reading model of worked problems in curriculum notations, not by a language model.

Civilisations: study activity is low per day (4-15 sessions per 2 days in a development population, most first sessions are placement tests); hiring in civ starts only after day 2 (firms wait 2 days after posting).

Technology invention (techmkt) and factory staffing from the labour market (plantlabor) are composed into a civilisation only through Domain.tier3 of those domains, not by civ.generate (civ/generator.py is not dom2's file: see integration_notes).
Invention reference: 2 of 3 reference runs succeed (seed 0 has no adopter: plants keep a technology only on their own noisy measurements).
Evaluators of 9.7 and 9.10 simulate a counterfactual world (same spec, seat idle) on the evaluator side: verify() costs about one extra world run (60-150 s on one CPU for 9.10).

Firms' internal operations tasks require 50-85% of the firm's own skill level, so most employees' measured work quality there is near the ceiling (wide_certified, 12 days: mean 0.99 with and 0.99 without the education subsystem, 7 records each): verified records discriminate little among employees doing routine work, and education's effect on labour outcomes runs through profiles (requirement gaps, shortlists, certificates, productivity up to the 1.3 cap) and through work quality only on demanding tasks (the participant's commissioned project, levels 0.35-0.6, mean quality 0.81). An outcome-level effect of education on hires or quality was not measurable at this scale.

9.7: the reference succeeds on 10 of 15 instances (scripted). It fails where the incumbent itself has no slack (single_site_tou s2: growth and a tenant release raise the always-on fleet's peak utilisation from 0.30 to 0.57) and where heat waves and failures (not replayed by fleet.experiment) cost attainment after deployment (follow_sun_heat s0, s2). Total traffic is not comparable between the policy world and the counterfactual: the population diverges by ~1% when the seat only reads (a kernel-level property of population scheduling), so the evaluator compares the tenants' deterministic share decisions and quality-driven user departures instead.

9.6: reference feasibility 9/15 over every configuration x 3 seeds (scripted); extraction_linear 0/3 (a single mine with under one run a day: the measured trial window mixes exploration points and the plant reverts or keeps a point with a tiny true gain; the market's openctl trial first delays it), forming_diamond 1/3. The reference's slow-plant plan is kept: without it 2 of the first 9 instances succeeded (extraction 1/3, forming 1/3, assembly 0/3).
9.9: no quit was produced by the rival's competition within 32 days (Retention is exercised by satisfaction tracking and departures).

9.7 counterfactual noise (kernel-level): every recorded command, reading ones too, shifts the main-line position that ctx.rng draws (pop.tick) are keyed by, so the policy world and the idle counterfactual diverge as soon as the seat calls any tool (follow_sun_heat s0: a read-only seat lost 0.0036 and 0.020 of a day's attainment in its first two days). The evaluator compares reliability only from the participant's first state-changing command; noise after it remains and is absorbed by the tolerances (attainment 0.001, users 1.25x+20, share 0.02).

9.6 adoption is confounded by machine wear: plants compare their cost per good during the trial with the runs before it, and wear grows between maintenances, so a technology with +3.7% true efficiency measured -8.5% (forming_diamond s0, forge1). The reference fails forming_standard s0 and forming_diamond s0 (eval_compositional) under framework/3 (0 adopters each); forming_standard s2, forming_diamond s1, any_wide s0 succeed.

Actors dropped under framework/3 because their events are recorded by system processes, not decisions: 9.9 workers (labor.perf), 9.10 Board of Education (learn.summary), 9.7 repair crew (fleet.repair).
